items.name: derive_dst
items.description: Derive macro for DST structs: generates a private `UninitFoo` MaybeUninit mirror, safe allocation constructors (`new_uninit_for_size` / `new_uninit_for_count` returning the box with its `Layout`, tail offset & count), an unsafe `assume_init`, and layout constructors (`layout_for_size` / `layout_for_count`) returning `LayoutError`. Requires nightly.

items.name: dvr-runtime
items.description: Sans-IO DVR archive: the on-disk period format (an append-only HLS media playlist per period plus one media file), the writer's roll and retention state machine that returns a plan of storage operations, catch-up read planning, and typeless recovery. No I/O unless the `fs` feature is on, no clock reads.
